text: Applicants should be healthy and well-behaved, and have a foreign citizenship.Applicants should have good academic records and an educational background equivalent to that of the Chinese high school diploma.Applicants should be between the ages of 18 and 25. Language RequirementsEnglish language proficiency certificate is required for programs taught in English and applicants who are not nativeEnglish speakers, which include score report of English Proficiency test likeTOEFL 80+/ IELTS 6.0+/ TOEFL My Best/ TOEFL iBT Home Edition/ TOEFL Essentials, and etc. For applicants who cannot offer the above-mentioned standardized English test results, they will be required to participate in an additional oral or written English test organized by Wuhan University of Technology.
